title: Automatic Door Locker (Locki)
what: A universal retrofit smart lock featuring a high-torque compound gear train and custom embedded controller.
why: To automate standard deadbolt operation without requiring permanent modifications to the door hardware or lock cylinder.
how: Designed a multi-stage gear reduction in SolidWorks, routed a custom Altium PCB with TMC2209 silent stepper driver, and wrote MicroPython firmware with sensorless stall homing on RP2040.
